name: Accellence Home Medical
old_description: Accellence Home Medical is a locally owned Durable Medical Equipment company serving the Reno, Sparks, Carson and surrounding areas, since 1997.
about:
Accellence Home Medical has operated as a locally owned durable medical equipment provider in Reno, Nevada since 1997. The company serves communities across northern Nevada and the eastern Sierra, including Sparks, Carson City, Fernley, Fallon, Minden, Gardnerville, Dayton, Virginia City, Silver Springs, Yerington, Wellington, Smith Valley, and California locations such as Loyalton, Portola, Graegle, Clio, Beckwourth, Truckee, and the Lake Tahoe area.

The business supplies and services a range of home medical equipment, including oxygen systems, power wheelchairs, CPAP and BiPAP devices, nebulizers, manual wheelchairs, hospital beds, bedside commodes, shower chairs, and walkers. It functions as a distributor and service provider rather than a manufacturer, delivering equipment to patients in residential and care settings.

Its customer base consists primarily of individuals requiring home healthcare equipment across the listed service areas, as well as healthcare providers and facilities in the region. The company focuses on the durable medical equipment segment of the healthcare industry.

The company emphasizes its local ownership and long-standing presence in the region since 1997.
